acceptance_checks: Emit command strings include the resolved task reference.
Task status/history human output shows the resolved task line and session suffix only when session-derived.
constraints: Keep the change bounded to artifact-loop.

acceptance_checks: Updated CLI tests pass for explicit and session-derived flows.
definition_of_done.behavior_outcome: Human-readable emit and task-read commands disclose the resolved task source consistently.
definition_of_done.rollback_or_fallback: Revert helper/caller edits and rebuild dist if human output regressions appear.
definition_of_done.verifier_acceptance_condition: Reviewer confirms the shared helper centralizes the string rule without widening API scope.

failure_signals: Session-derived tests fail to surface the resolved task ID.
fallback_or_rollback: Revert the shared task reference helper and restore previous human-output strings.
primary_behavior: Implement shared task-source labeling across emit, task status, and task history human output.
verifier_mapping: Existing emit/status/history vitest assertions plus reviewer inspection of human-only output changes.
